description: Defines data structures, enums, and constants for configuring CSI (Channel State Information) reports in a 5G NR system, including report types, periodicity, CQI tables, and resource configurations.

classes.name: csi_report_config
classes.description: Configuration structure for CSI report settings, including resource identifiers, report type, periodicity, CQI settings, and measurement restrictions.

classes.name: csi_report_config::pucch_csi_resource
classes.description: Represents PUCCH resource configuration for CSI reporting.

classes.name: csi_report_config::periodic_or_semi_persistent_report_on_pucch
classes.description: Configuration for periodic or semi-persistent CSI reports on PUCCH.

classes.name: csi_report_config::semi_persistent_report_on_pusch
classes.description: Configuration for semi-persistent CSI reports on PUSCH.

classes.name: csi_report_config::report_frequency_config
classes.description: Frequency domain reporting configuration for CSI.

classes.name: csi_report_config::port_index_for_8_ranks
classes.description: Port index configuration for up to 8 ranks in CSI reporting.

methods.name: csi_report_periodicity_to_uint
methods.description: Converts csi_report_periodicity enum to its unsigned integer value.
